title: Uruguayan Amber Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Uruguayan-inspired stew made with amber and tofu, perfect for a comforting vegan meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the ground uruguayan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the diced stew and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tofu and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until heated through.
Stir in the amber and cook for 1-2 minutes, until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
